QuestionText: A company is evaluating a migration from its on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud. Which of the following is a key financial advantage of cloud computing identified by AWS?
Options: It eliminates all computing costs after the initial migration.
It trades upfront capital expenses (CapEx) for variable expenses (OpEx) that scale with actual usage.
It requires customers to buy physical hardware in bulk to receive discounts.
It locks customers into long-term contracts for every service they use.
Explanation: Prelazak sa sopstvenog data centra na AWS omogućava zamenu velikih početnih kapitalnih ulaganja promenljivim troškovima prema korišćenju. Stvarni trošak zavisi od izabranih servisa, konfiguracije i potrošnje.

QuestionText: AWS can offer lower pay-as-you-go prices than many traditional IT providers. Which concept primarily explains this advantage?
Options: Economies of scale from aggregating usage across a very large number of customers
Reserved capacity discounts that every customer receives automatically
Explanation: Ekonomija obima znači da AWS objedinjuje potražnju velikog broja klijenata i može da nabavlja infrastrukturu efikasnije, što omogućava niže jedinične cene. Popusti za obavezani obim korišćenja su zasebni cenovni modeli.

QuestionText: An e-commerce company expects a large traffic spike during a seasonal sale, followed by a return to normal levels. Which cloud characteristic allows it to add compute capacity for the spike and release it afterwards, paying only for what it uses?
Explanation: Elastičnost je sposobnost dodavanja i uklanjanja kapaciteta prema promeni potražnje, na primer uz EC2 Auto Scaling. Ona pomaže da se izbegne plaćanje nepotrebnog kapaciteta; naplata ipak zavisi od izabranih resursa. Trajnost podataka nije isto što i dostupnost aplikacije.

QuestionText: A company runs a critical web application in a single data center. Management requires that the failure of a single facility must not take the application offline. What is the recommended AWS approach?
Options: Run the application on a larger EC2 instance type in the same Availability Zone.
Take hourly Amazon EBS snapshots of the instance.
Deploy the application across multiple edge locations.
Deploy the application across multiple Availability Zones in the same Region behind an Elastic Load Balancer.
Explanation: Raspoređivanje aplikacije u više Availability Zones i usmeravanje saobraćaja preko Elastic Load Balancing smanjuje rizik da otkazivanje jednog objekta prekine uslugu. Veća instanca u jednoj zoni i snapshot ne obezbeđuju automatski nastavak rada.

QuestionText: Under the AWS shared responsibility model, which task is the responsibility of AWS?
Options: Configuring security groups on an Amazon EC2 instance
Securing the physical infrastructure — data center facilities, hardware, and networking — that runs all AWS services
Patching the guest operating system on an Amazon EC2 instance
Managing IAM users, groups, and roles in a customer account
Explanation: AWS odgovara za bezbednost fizičkih objekata, hardvera i osnovne infrastrukture oblaka. Korisnik upravlja pristupom, podacima i konfiguracijom svojih resursa; za EC2 to uključuje i gostujući operativni sistem.

QuestionText: A development team wants to experiment more cheaply and quickly: spin up test environments in minutes and destroy them as soon as the experiment is over. Which benefit of the AWS Cloud does this describe?
Explanation: Agility označava mogućnost brzog nabavljanja resursa i eksperimentisanja bez dugog ciklusa kupovine hardvera. Trošak resursa tokom eksperimenta i dalje zavisi od njihovog korišćenja.

QuestionText: A security review finds that an IAM user has the AdministratorAccess managed policy attached, although the user only needs to read objects from one Amazon S3 bucket. Which security principle is being violated?
Explanation: Načelo najmanjih privilegija traži samo dozvole potrebne za konkretan zadatak. AdministratorAccess je preširok za čitanje jednog S3 bucketa; odgovarajuća usko ograničena IAM politika smanjuje rizik.

QuestionText: An application running on an Amazon EC2 instance needs read access to an Amazon S3 bucket. What is the AWS best practice for granting these permissions?
Options: Create an IAM user, generate long-term access keys, and hardcode them in the application.
Store the credentials of the AWS account root user on the instance.
Make the S3 bucket publicly readable.
Attach an IAM role with the required permissions policy to the EC2 instance.
Explanation: IAM role dodeljena EC2 instanci daje aplikaciji privremene kredencijale preko instance profile-a. Time se izbegavaju dugoročni ključevi u kodu; politika role treba da dozvoli samo potrebno čitanje iz S3.

QuestionText: Which AWS feature adds a second authentication factor, beyond the password, to better protect the AWS account root user?
Explanation: MFA dodaje drugi faktor prijave i preporučena je zaštita root korisnika. AWS podržava kompatibilne MFA metode, uključujući passkeys/security keys i autentifikatorske aplikacije; izbor zavisi od zahteva organizacije.

QuestionText: A company wants to centrally govern multiple AWS accounts: group them into one organization, receive a single bill, and restrict which AWS services and actions member accounts can use. Which service provides these capabilities?
Explanation: AWS Organizations grupiše naloge, omogućava objedinjenu naplatu i centralnu kontrolu uz SCP. SCP ograničava maksimalno raspoložive dozvole, ali sam ne dodeljuje pristup.

QuestionText: An auditor asks for AWS third-party compliance attestations — such as SOC reports and ISO certifications — that apply to the AWS Cloud. Where should the company download these documents?
Explanation: AWS Artifact pruža samouslužni pristup AWS izveštajima o usklađenosti i relevantnim ugovorima. ACM upravlja TLS sertifikatima, a Inspector traži ranjivosti u podržanim radnim opterećenjima.

QuestionText: Which AWS service automatically protects every AWS customer against common infrastructure-level (Layer 3/Layer 4) DDoS attacks at no additional charge?
Explanation: AWS Shield Standard je automatski dostupan korisnicima bez dodatne naknade i pruža zaštitu od čestih mrežnih i transportnih DDoS napada. AWS WAF filtrira HTTP(S) zahteve na aplikacionom sloju.

QuestionText: A security policy requires that data stored in Amazon S3 be encrypted, and that the company controls the encryption keys, their rotation, and an audit trail of key usage. Which service should the company use?
Explanation: Za S3 SSE-KMS korisnik može da koristi AWS KMS ključeve i kontroliše pristup njima. KMS podržava rotaciju odgovarajućih ključeva, a relevantni API događaji mogu se evidentirati u CloudTrail-u; postavke rotacije i beleženja treba proveriti za konkretan tip ključa.

QuestionText: What best describes an AWS Availability Zone?
Options: A geographic area in the world where AWS clusters data centers, such as Europe (Stockholm)
One or more discrete data centers with redundant power, networking, and connectivity, located within a Region
A location that caches copies of content physically close to end users
An isolated segment of a customer's VPC into which resources are launched
Explanation: Availability Zone obuhvata jedan ili više odvojenih data centara unutar Regiona, sa redundantnom infrastrukturom. Region je geografska oblast, edge lokacija približava sadržaj korisnicima, a subnet je deo VPC mreže.

QuestionText: A company runs a MySQL database and wants AWS to handle server maintenance, OS patching, and automated backups, while continuing to use standard SQL. Which service best fits this requirement?
Options: Amazon EC2 with a self-managed MySQL installation
Explanation: Amazon RDS je upravljana relacijska baza koja podržava MySQL i automatizuje uobičajene zadatke poput održavanja infrastrukture, patchovanja i backup-a. Korisnik i dalje upravlja šemom, upitima i pristupom bazi. DynamoDB je NoSQL servis, a Redshift analitičko skladište podataka.

QuestionText: A financial firm must retain compliance archives for 10 years at the lowest possible storage cost; a retrieval time of up to 12 hours is acceptable. Which Amazon S3 storage class is the most cost-effective choice?
Explanation: S3 Glacier Deep Archive namenjen je vrlo retko korišćenim dugoročnim arhivama i ima najnižu cenu skladištenja među S3 klasama. Standardno vraćanje tipično završava u roku od 12 sati; bulk vraćanje može trajati do 48 sati. Minimalno obračunsko trajanje je 180 dana.

QuestionText: A developer wants to run a Python function that processes images automatically every time a new file is uploaded to Amazon S3, without managing any servers. Which service should they use?
Explanation: AWS Lambda izvršava kod na događaje kao što je S3 upload bez upravljanja serverima. Trošak zavisi od konfiguracije i korišćenja; ne svodi se samo na broj poziva. EC2 zahteva upravljanje instancama.

QuestionText: A media company wants to serve video content to a global audience with low latency by caching copies of files physically closer to viewers. Which service should they use?
Explanation: Amazon CloudFront je CDN koji kešira i distribuira sadržaj preko edge lokacija blizu korisnika. Route 53 je DNS, a Global Accelerator poboljšava putanju mrežnog saobraćaja bez CDN keširanja objekata.

QuestionText: After a security incident, a team must determine exactly who launched a specific Amazon EC2 instance and when. Which AWS service records this account API activity?
Explanation: AWS CloudTrail beleži API aktivnost, uključujući poziv za pokretanje EC2 instance i identitet pozivaoca. Event history podrazumevano prikazuje 90 dana management događaja; za duže čuvanje i dodatne tipove događaja konfigurišu se odgovarajući CloudTrail mehanizmi.

QuestionText: A company will run steady, predictable production workloads 24/7 for the next 3 years and wants to minimize compute costs. Which pricing option should they choose?
Explanation: Savings Plans nude popust uz obavezu određenog iznosa potrošnje po satu tokom 1 ili 3 godine, pa odgovaraju predvidljivom korišćenju. Tačan nivo uštede zavisi od plana i konfiguracije; Spot kapacitet može biti prekinut.

QuestionText: Which EC2 purchasing option offers a discount of up to 90% compared to On-Demand pricing, in exchange for the possibility that AWS reclaims the capacity with a two-minute interruption notice?
Explanation: EC2 Spot Instances koriste neiskorišćeni kapacitet uz popust do 90% u odnosu na On-Demand, ali mogu biti prekinute, obično uz upozorenje od dva minuta. Zato odgovaraju poslovima koji podnose prekid.

QuestionText: The finance team wants an email notification whenever actual or forecasted monthly spending exceeds 80% of the planned amount. Which AWS tool should they configure?
Explanation: AWS Budgets prati zadati prag potrošnje ili korišćenja i može poslati obaveštenje na osnovu stvarnih ili prognoziranih troškova. Cost Explorer služi analizi i prognoziranju troškova; za ovaj konkretan budžetski prag koristi se Budgets.

QuestionText: Before deploying a new workload, a solutions architect wants to estimate the expected monthly AWS cost of the planned configuration. Which tool should be used?
Explanation: AWS Pricing Calculator procenjuje cenu planirane konfiguracije pre implementacije. Cost Explorer analizira postojeće i prognozirane troškove naloga, a Budgets prati pragove.

QuestionText: A company has multiple AWS accounts and wants a single monthly bill for all of them, with usage combined so that Reserved Instance and Savings Plans benefits can be shared across the accounts. Which capability provides this?
Explanation: AWS Organizations consolidated billing objedinjuje račun više naloga. Podrazumevano može da objedini korišćenje za cenovne nivoe i deli odgovarajuće RI/Savings Plans popuste, uz mogućnost upravljanja deljenjem popusta.

QuestionText: Which AWS Support plan is included at no additional cost for every AWS customer account?
Explanation: Basic Support je uključen u svaki AWS nalog bez dodatne naknade i obuhvata pomoć za nalog i naplatu, AWS Health i osnovne Trusted Advisor provere. Plaćeni planovi pružaju tehničku podršku. AWS trenutno navodi Business Support+, Enterprise Support i Unified Operations; postojeći Developer i Business planovi imaju najavljen kraj podrške 1. januara 2027.

QuestionText: Under the current AWS Free Tier model, what does a new customer receive when creating an AWS account?
Options: Unlimited free access to all AWS services for one year
A 50% discount on all AWS services for the first 12 months
$100 in credits at sign-up, with the opportunity to earn up to $100 more; a Free plan can last up to 6 months
One year of unlimited free Amazon EC2 and Amazon S3 usage
Explanation: Novi korisnik dobija 100 USD kredita pri otvaranju naloga i može zaraditi do još 100 USD. Free plan traje najviše šest meseci ili do potrošnje kredita; krediti za novi nalog mogu se koristiti i na Paid planu do isteka prema uslovima AWS-a. Always Free ponude imaju posebne mesečne limite.

QuestionText: A team wants to avoid purchasing servers months before demand is known. Which cloud benefit allows it to provision resources when needed?
Explanation: On-demand kapacitet omogućava nabavku resursa po potrebi, bez unapred kupljenih servera.

QuestionText: Which TWO practices improve the availability of an application on AWS? (Choose 2.)
Options: Run every instance in one Availability Zone
Use Elastic Load Balancing across healthy targets
Explanation: Više AZ-ova smanjuje uticaj otkaza jedne lokacije, a load balancer usmerava saobraćaj ka zdravim ciljevima.

QuestionText: Which AWS Well-Architected pillar focuses on recovering from disruptions and meeting demand?
Explanation: Reliability pillar obuhvata oporavak od prekida i prilagođavanje promenama potražnje.

QuestionText: Which AWS Well-Architected pillar emphasizes using computing resources efficiently as requirements change?
Explanation: Performance Efficiency se bavi efikasnim korišćenjem resursa i njihovim prilagođavanjem promenljivim zahtevima.

QuestionText: Which TWO statements describe benefits of cloud computing? (Choose 2.)
Options: Every workload has zero operating cost
Customers must own AWS data centers
Explanation: Brzo obezbeđivanje resursa i elastično skaliranje su osnovne prednosti cloud-a. Cloud i dalje ima troškove i različite modele naplate.

QuestionText: A company wants to deploy a service in a new geographic market without building a local data center. Which AWS Cloud benefit is most relevant?
Explanation: AWS globalna infrastruktura omogućava postavljanje resursa u izabranim regionima blizu korisnika bez izgradnje sopstvenog data centra.

QuestionText: A workload should continue serving users if one Availability Zone becomes unavailable. Which concept is being prioritized?
Explanation: High availability se poboljšava raspoređivanjem kapaciteta preko više AZ-ova i preusmeravanjem saobraćaja kada deo infrastrukture otkaže.

QuestionText: A company wants to move an application to AWS with minimal changes to the application. Which migration strategy does this describe?
Explanation: Rehosting, odnosno lift and shift, premešta aplikaciju u AWS bez značajnih promena u samoj aplikaciji.

QuestionText: A company wants to estimate and reduce environmental impact from AWS usage. Which Well-Architected pillar addresses this goal?
Explanation: Sustainability pillar se odnosi na smanjenje uticaja cloud radnih opterećenja na životnu sredinu.

QuestionText: Which TWO actions can help control cloud costs through right-sizing and resource management? (Choose 2.)
Options: Choose resource sizes that match workload needs
Stop unused resources when they are no longer needed
Always buy the largest instance available
Keep all test environments running permanently
Explanation: Right-sizing usklađuje veličinu resursa sa stvarnom potražnjom, a gašenje nekorišćenih resursa smanjuje nepotrebnu potrošnju.

QuestionText: A company needs one place to give employees access to multiple AWS accounts with a single sign-on experience. Which service fits?
Explanation: IAM Identity Center centralizuje pristup zaposlenih AWS nalozima i aplikacijama uz SSO.

QuestionText: Which TWO actions are recommended for the AWS account root user? (Choose 2.)
Options: Use it for all daily administration
Store root access keys in source code
Avoid using it for everyday tasks
Share its password with the team
Explanation: Root korisnik ima široka ovlašćenja: uključiti MFA i koristiti ga samo za zadatke koji ga zahtevaju.

QuestionText: A company wants to identify potentially malicious activity in AWS accounts using threat intelligence and log analysis. Which service should it use?
Explanation: Amazon GuardDuty je servis za detekciju pretnji koji analizira relevantne izvore podataka i nalazi sumnjivu aktivnost.

QuestionText: A company needs to find sensitive personal information in Amazon S3 buckets. Which service is designed for this task?
Explanation: Amazon Macie otkriva osetljive podatke, uključujući PII, u S3.

QuestionText: Which TWO controls can help reduce unintended public access to Amazon S3 data? (Choose 2.)
Explanation: S3 Block Public Access i usko ograničene bucket politike smanjuju rizik od nenamernog javnog pristupa.

QuestionText: A company needs a record of configuration changes to supported AWS resources and compliance against rules. Which service should it use?
Explanation: AWS Config prati konfiguraciju podržanih resursa kroz vreme i može proveravati usklađenost sa pravilima.

QuestionText: An application needs a managed place to store and rotate database credentials. Which service best fits?
Explanation: AWS Secrets Manager čuva tajne aplikacija i podržava njihovu rotaciju, uključujući kredencijale baza.

QuestionText: Which service filters malicious HTTP requests, including common web exploits, before they reach an application?
Explanation: AWS WAF filtrira HTTP(S) zahteve pravilima radi zaštite web aplikacija od uobičajenih napada.

QuestionText: Which TWO statements about AWS Organizations service control policies (SCPs) are correct? (Choose 2.)
Options: They set permission guardrails for accounts in an organization
They grant IAM users permissions directly
They can limit available AWS actions
They replace IAM policies for granting access
Explanation: SCP postavlja granice dozvola za naloge u organizaciji, ali pristup mora biti dodeljen drugim politikama.

QuestionText: An auditor needs evidence of who called a particular AWS API action. Which service provides the relevant event history?
Explanation: CloudTrail beleži API pozive i identitet pozivaoca; podrazumevani Event history obuhvata 90 dana management događaja.

QuestionText: A web application needs object storage for images and documents. Which AWS service is the best fit?
Explanation: Amazon S3 je objektno skladište pogodno za slike, dokumente i druge fajlove.

QuestionText: An EC2 instance needs a persistent block storage volume. Which service should it use?
Explanation: Amazon EBS pruža blokovske volumene koji se koriste uz EC2 instance.

QuestionText: Several Linux EC2 instances need to share a managed file system. Which service is appropriate?
Explanation: Amazon EFS je upravljan elastičan fajl sistem koji može deliti više Linux instanci.

QuestionText: Which TWO AWS services are serverless compute options? (Choose 2.)
Explanation: Lambda izvršava funkcije bez upravljanja serverima, a Fargate pokreće kontejnere bez upravljanja osnovnim serverima.

QuestionText: A team needs a managed NoSQL key-value database with low-latency access. Which service should it choose?
Explanation: Amazon DynamoDB je upravljana NoSQL baza za key-value i dokumentne podatke sa niskom latencijom.

QuestionText: Which service translates a domain name into the address of an application endpoint?
Explanation: Amazon Route 53 je DNS servis koji povezuje domene sa odredištima kao što su web aplikacije.

QuestionText: A company needs an isolated virtual network in AWS to launch its resources. Which service provides it?
Explanation: Amazon VPC omogućava logički izolovanu virtuelnu mrežu za AWS resurse.

QuestionText: Which TWO tasks are common uses of Amazon CloudWatch? (Choose 2.)
Explanation: CloudWatch prikuplja metrike i omogućava alarme na osnovu zadatih uslova.

QuestionText: A company wants to decouple two application components using a managed message queue. Which service should it use?
Explanation: Amazon SQS je upravljan red poruka koji omogućava asinhronu komunikaciju i razdvajanje komponenti.

QuestionText: Which service provides a managed data warehouse for analytical SQL queries across large datasets?
Explanation: Amazon Redshift je upravljano analitičko skladište podataka namenjeno upitima nad velikim skupovima podataka.

QuestionText: A team has short, unpredictable EC2 usage and does not want a long-term commitment. Which purchasing option fits best?
Explanation: On-Demand omogućava plaćanje EC2 kapaciteta bez dugoročne obaveze i odgovara promenljivom korišćenju.

QuestionText: Which TWO AWS tools help a company inspect historical spending and receive alerts when a budget threshold is crossed? (Choose 2.)
Explanation: Cost Explorer analizira istorijsku potrošnju, a Budgets upozorava kada trošak ili prognoza pređu zadati prag.

QuestionText: A finance team needs a detailed record of AWS usage and cost line items for its own analysis. Which data source should it use?
Explanation: AWS Cost and Usage Report daje detaljne podatke o korišćenju i trošku za dalju analizu.

QuestionText: A company wants to group AWS costs by project using labels assigned to resources. What should it use?
Explanation: Aktivirani cost allocation tagovi omogućavaju grupisanje troškova po oznakama resursa, na primer po projektu.

QuestionText: Which EC2 pricing model is best suited to interruption-tolerant batch jobs seeking deep discounts?
Explanation: Spot koristi neiskorišćeni EC2 kapacitet sa popustom, uz mogućnost prekida, pa odgovara batch poslovima koji mogu da se ponove.

QuestionText: A company commits to a consistent amount of compute usage for one or three years. Which pricing model can reduce its cost?
Explanation: Savings Plans daju popust za obavezani iznos korišćenja po satu tokom jedne ili tri godine.

QuestionText: Which TWO features are available to all AWS customers through Basic Support? (Choose 2.)
Options: Help with account and billing questions
Explanation: Basic Support uključuje podršku za nalog i naplatu i osnovne Trusted Advisor provere; napredna tehnička podrška pripada plaćenim planovima.

QuestionText: Before creating resources, a company wants to compare estimated monthly prices for two AWS configurations. Which tool should it use?
Explanation: AWS Pricing Calculator modeluje očekivane troškove planiranih konfiguracija pre implementacije.

QuestionText: Which AWS capability lets multiple accounts receive one consolidated bill?
Explanation: Consolidated billing u AWS Organizations objedinjuje naplatu naloga u organizaciji.

QuestionText: Which TWO statements about AWS Free Tier for new customers are accurate? (Choose 2.)
Options: New customers receive $100 in credits at sign-up
Eligible activities can earn up to $100 additional credits
All AWS services are free without limits for one year
A Free plan stays open indefinitely after credits are exhausted
Every EC2 instance type is always free
Explanation: Novi korisnici dobijaju 100 USD kredita i mogu zaraditi do još 100 USD kroz kvalifikovane aktivnosti; Free plan ima vremenska i kreditna ograničenja.

QuestionText: Which statement best describes cloud computing?
Options: On-demand delivery of IT resources over the internet with pay-as-you-go pricing
Buying physical servers and renting them to other companies
A single data center owned and operated by one company
Software that runs only on personal laptops
Explanation: Cloud computing je obezbeđivanje IT resursa (računanje, skladištenje, baze, mreže) na zahtev preko interneta, uz naplatu po stvarnom korišćenju, bez unapred kupljenog i održavanog hardvera.

QuestionText: Which of the following is NOT one of the six advantages of cloud computing identified by AWS?
Options: Trade capital expense for variable expense
Benefit from massive economies of scale
Guaranteed lowest total cost of ownership for every workload
Explanation: AWS navodi šest prednosti: zamena CapEx promenljivim troškovima, ekonomija obima, prestanak nagađanja kapaciteta, brzina i okretnost, prestanak troškova data centra i globalno prisustvo za minute. Garantovano najniži TCO ne postoji — ušteda zavisi od arhitekture i korišćenja.

QuestionText: A startup cannot predict how popular its new application will be. Which advantage of the AWS Cloud removes the need to buy capacity in advance and hope that demand matches it?
Options: Benefit from massive economies of scale
Explanation: Uz cloud ne kupuješ unapred hardver za mogući vršni obim — kapacitet se dodaje kad tražnja poraste i plaća se po stvarnom korišćenju, čime nestaju rizici prekomernog i nedovoljnog dimenzionisanja.

QuestionText: A payment system must keep processing with no downtime and no lost transactions even while one of its components is failing. Which characteristic is required?
Explanation: Fault tolerance znači neprekidan rad i tokom greške komponente (redundantne paralelne instance preuzimaju odmah). High availability prihvata kratak prekid zbog failover-a. Pravilo za ispit: zero downtime → fault tolerance; minimal downtime → high availability.

QuestionText: An application is scaled by adding more EC2 instances behind a load balancer instead of switching to a larger instance type. Which approach is this?
Explanation: Horizontalno skaliranje dodaje i oduzima instance istog tipa, a load balancer raspoređuje saobraćaj — osnova EC2 Auto Scaling-a. Vertikalno skaliranje menja instancu većom, sa gornjom granicom i obično uz restart.

QuestionText: Which term describes a system's ability to handle demand growth over time — for example, growing from 100 to 100,000 users — not necessarily automatically?
Explanation: Skalabilnost je sposobnost rasta sistema sa potrebama dodavanjem resursa, bez obzira na automatizaciju. Elastičnost je uži pojam — automatsko prilagođavanje kapaciteta trenutnoj tražnji u realnom vremenu.

QuestionText: A company compares running workloads on premises versus on AWS over three years. Which set of costs must be included on the on-premises side for an accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) comparison?
Options: Only the initial purchase price of servers
Hardware, power and cooling, facilities, and IT staff to run and maintain everything
Explanation: TCO obuhvata sve troškove posedovanja: hardver, struju i hlađenje, prostorije i IT osoblje za održavanje — ne samo nabavnu cenu servera. Poređenja koja računaju samo hardver potcenjuju on-premises trošak.

QuestionText: Which design principle tells an architect to assume that every component will eventually fail, and to build the system so that a failure does not stop the service?
Options: Design for failure — remove single points of failure
Tightly couple components so they share state
Rely on one large instance to minimize the number of components
Require manual recovery for every failure
Explanation: Design for failure pretpostavlja kvar svake komponente i projektuje redundantnost: više instanci, više Availability Zones, health check-ovi i automatska zamena. Jedna velika instanca i tesno vezivanje komponenti su anti-patterns.

QuestionText: An order service sends requests to a payment service through a message queue, so a payment failure does not immediately break order placement. Which design principle is this?
Explanation: Loose coupling znači da komponente komuniciraju preko posrednika (npr. Amazon SQS reda poruka), pa kvar ili izmena jedne komponente ne ruši ostale. Tesno vezane komponente prenose greške kroz ceo lanac.

QuestionText: Which application architecture is easiest to scale horizontally, because any instance can serve any user request?
Options: Stateless — session data is kept outside the instance, for example in a database or cache
Stateful — user sessions are stored on each instance's local disk
A single-threaded monolith on one instance
An architecture that requires each request to always reach the same instance
Explanation: Stateless aplikacije ne drže sesije lokalno, pa load balancer može proslediti zahtev bilo kojoj instanci, a Auto Scaling slobodno dodaje i oduzima instance. Stateful arhitekture zahtevaju sticky sesije i teže se skaliraju.

QuestionText: Regulation requires a company to keep personally identifiable data in its own data center, while the public web tier can run in the AWS Cloud. Which deployment model is this?
Explanation: Hybrid model kombinuje on-premises infrastrukturu i javni cloud u jednu celinu (npr. preko VPN-a ili Direct Connect-a; AWS Outposts donosi AWS servise u sopstveni data centar). Multi-cloud je korišćenje više javnih oblaka istovremeno.

QuestionText: Which TWO are cloud deployment models recognized by AWS? (Choose 2.)
Explanation: Modeli raspoređivanja su public, private/on-premises i hybrid. Elastičnost i CapEx su pojmovi o ekonomiji cloud-a, a Availability Zone je deo AWS globalne infrastrukture.

QuestionText: An IT team wants full control over operating systems, storage, and networking, but does not want to own physical hardware. Which cloud service model fits?
Explanation: IaaS (npr. Amazon EC2) daje virtualnu infrastrukturu kojom klijent upravlja — OS, patch-evi, aplikacija — dok AWS drži fizički hardver. Ka višim modelima klijentska kontrola opada.

QuestionText: A developer wants to upload application code and have AWS handle server provisioning, load balancing, and scaling of the platform. Which service model is this?
Explanation: PaaS znači da provajder upravlja platformom na koju se samo postavlja kod (primer na AWS-u je AWS Elastic Beanstalk). IaaS zahteva i upravljanje OS-om, a SaaS je gotov proizvod.

QuestionText: A company starts using a complete email and calendar product delivered over the internet, without managing any servers, storage, or patches. Which service model is this?
Explanation: SaaS je potpuno gotova aplikacija preko interneta — korisnik samo koristi proizvod (npr. webmail ili AWS WorkMail), bez vidljive infrastrukture i platforme.

QuestionText: Which AWS Well-Architected pillar focuses on the processes and procedures used to operate and monitor workloads and to drive continuous improvement?
Explanation: Operational Excellence obuhvata operativne procese: automatizaciju izmena, monitoring, upravljanje incidentima i kontinuirano unapređenje. Šest stupova: Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization i Sustainability.

QuestionText: A team continuously reviews utilization and eliminates waste, such as idle load balancers and oversized instances. Which Well-Architected pillar does this support?
Explanation: Cost Optimization obuhvata right-sizing, gašenje neiskorišćenih resursa, odgovarajuće cenovne modele (Savings Plans, Spot) i analizu troškova. Right-sizing je njen najpoznatiji mehanizam.

QuestionText: What does the AWS Well-Architected Framework provide?
Options: A billing dashboard for tracking monthly spend
A compliance report repository for auditors
A network of edge locations for content delivery
A set of best-practice design pillars for building and evaluating workloads in the cloud
Explanation: Well-Architected Framework je skup najboljih praksi u šest stupova za projektovanje i procenu arhitektura; uz njega postoji i besplatan AWS Well-Architected Tool za samoprocenu radnih opterećenja.

QuestionText: A company wants to eliminate the costs of running its own facilities — power, cooling, and hardware maintenance. Which advantage of cloud computing addresses this?
Options: Trade capital expense for variable expense
Benefit from massive economies of scale
Stop spending money running and maintaining data centers
Explanation: Ovo je izričito jedna od šest prednosti AWS Cloud-a: prestanak ulaganja u objekte, struju, hlađenje i održavanje hardvera — AWS sve to vodi kao deo infrastrukture koju deli sa svim klijentima.

QuestionText: Several developers need identical permissions to use Amazon S3. What is the simplest way to manage their access?
Options: Put the users in an IAM group and attach the policy to the group
Attach the same policy separately to every user
Share the root user credentials with all developers
Make the S3 bucket publicly accessible
Explanation: IAM grupa objedinjuje dozvole za više korisnika: politika se dodaje na jednom mestu, a članstvo u grupi daje svi korisnici iste dozvole. Deljenje kredencijala i javni bucket su ozbiljne bezbednosne greške.

QuestionText: An IAM user has one policy that allows s3:GetObject on all buckets and another policy that explicitly denies s3:GetObject on one specific bucket. What is the effective result for that bucket?
Options: Access is allowed, because two policies are merged into an average
Access is denied — an explicit Deny always overrides an Allow
The result depends on the alphabetical order of the policies
Only the root user can resolve policy conflicts
Explanation: U IAM proceni politika vredi osnovno pravilo: explicit Deny uvek pobeđuje sve Allow dozvole. Zato je najprečišće rešenje kad neki resurs mora ostati zaštićen i pored širih dozvola.

QuestionText: How can an IAM user in Account A temporarily access resources in Account B without creating any IAM users in Account B?
Options: By assuming an IAM role in Account B that grants the needed permissions
By sharing the root user password of Account B
By copying the S3 bucket policy from Account B
By enabling MFA in Account A
Explanation: IAM role sa poverenjem (trust policy) ka nalogu A omogućava korisniku da preuzme (assume) ulogu i dobije privremene kredencijale za nalog B. Trajni IAM korisnici i deljenje lozinki nisu potrebni.

QuestionText: Which AWS feature acts as a virtual firewall that controls inbound and outbound traffic at the EC2 instance level?
Explanation: Security group je virtualni firewall na nivou instance: definiše dozvoljeni ulazni i izlazni saobraćaj. IAM politike kontrolišu API akcije, a Shield i Macie rešavaju DDoS, odnosno osetljive podatke.

QuestionText: Which method protects data in transit between users and an AWS endpoint?
Options: Encrypting an EBS volume at rest
Storing data in S3 Glacier Deep Archive
Explanation: Data in transit (u pokretu) se štiti TLS/HTTPS enkripcijom kanala. Enkripcija EBS-a i Deep Archive štite podatke u mirovanju, a MFA je autentifikacija, ne enkripcija.

QuestionText: By default, all new objects uploaded to Amazon S3 are now automatically encrypted with which option?
Options: Server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3)
Server-side encryption with customer-managed KMS keys by default
No encryption unless the customer enables it
Explanation: Od 2023. S3 podrazumevano primenjuje SSE-S3 enkripciju na sve nove objekte, bez uticaja na performanse i bez dodatne cene. Po potrebi se može izabrati SSE-KMS ili SSE-C umesto podrazumevanog.

QuestionText: Which AWS service automatically scans EC2 instances and container images for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure?
Explanation: Amazon Inspector automatski pronalazi softverske ranjivosti i neželjenu mrežnu izloženost na EC2 instancama i ECR slikama. GuardDuty detektuje pretnje iz logova, Macie traži osetljive podatke, a Config prati konfiguracije.

QuestionText: Where can a company download AWS agreements such as the Business Associate Addendum (BAA) needed for HIPAA workloads?
Explanation: AWS Artifact pored izveštaja o usklađenosti (SOC, ISO, PCI) nudi i sporazume poput BAA i NDA za preuzimanje. ACM izdaje TLS sertifikate i nema veze sa ugovorima.

QuestionText: A compliance team wants to continuously collect evidence about its own AWS usage and check it against frameworks such as PCI DSS. Which service automates this?
Explanation: AWS Audit Manager automatizuje prikupljanje dokaza o upotrebi AWS-a i proveru prema okvirima usklađenosti. Razlika prema Artifact-u: Artifact je katalog gotovih AWS izveštaja i ugovora, a Audit Manager gradi reviziju tvoje sopstvene upotrebe.

QuestionText: Which service aggregates security findings from Amazon GuardDuty, Amazon Inspector, and Amazon Macie into a single, centralized view?
Explanation: AWS Security Hub objedinjuje nalaze bezbednosnih servisa u jedan pregled i proverava ih prema AWS security standardima. Organizations grupiše naloge, a Budgets prati troškove.

QuestionText: A mobile application needs user sign-up, sign-in, and access control for its own end users. Which service provides this?
Explanation: Amazon Cognito dodaje registraciju, prijavu i kontrolu pristupa korisnicima aplikacije. IAM i IAM Identity Center su za pristup AWS resursima i zaposlenima, ne za korisnike aplikacije.

QuestionText: An auditor requests a list of all IAM users in the account and the status of their passwords, access keys, and MFA. What should be generated?
Explanation: IAM credential report je izveštaj na nivou naloga sa statusom kredencijala svih korisnika: starost lozinke, aktivni access keys i da li je MFA omogućen. CloudTrail beleži API pozive, ne status kredencijala.

QuestionText: Which TWO tasks require the AWS account root user? (Choose 2.)
Options: Changing the root user email address or password
Explanation: Samo root može zatvoriti nalog i promeniti root email/lozinku; sve ostale svakodnevne zadatke treba obavljati sa IAM admin korisnikom. Zato se root koristi retko, uz MFA.

QuestionText: Which service provisions and manages public TLS certificates that can be attached to an Application Load Balancer at no additional charge?
Explanation: ACM izdaje, obnavlja i deploy-uje javne TLS sertifikate za AWS servise poput ALB-a i CloudFront-a bez naknade za javne sertifikate. KMS upravlja enkripcijskim ključevima, ne TLS sertifikatima.

QuestionText: A company wants around-the-clock access to the AWS DDoS Response Team (SRT) and financial protection against cost spikes caused by DDoS attacks. Which offering provides this?
Explanation: AWS Shield Advanced je plaćena nadogradnja: 24/7 DDoS Response Team, naprednija zaštita i cost protection protiv skoka računa usled napada. Shield Standard je besplatna osnovna L3/L4 zaštita za sve.

QuestionText: Under the shared responsibility model, who is responsible for the compliance of the customer's own applications and data stored in AWS?
Options: Compliance is not possible in the cloud
Explanation: AWS obezbeđuje usklađenost infrastrukture i sertifikate o njoj, ali usklađenost aplikacija, podataka i pristupa u oblaku ostaje odgovornost klijenta — klasična 'security and compliance IN the cloud' strana modela.

QuestionText: A European company must keep all customer data physically stored within the European Union. What is the primary way to satisfy this requirement on AWS?
Options: Deploy the workloads in an AWS Region located in the EU
Encrypt the data in any global Region
Explanation: Izbor Regiona je primarni mehanizam geografske kontrole podataka (data residency) — EU Regioni poput eu-west-1 ili eu-central-1 drže podatke u EU. Edge lokacije su CDN keš, a enkripcija ne menja lokaciju skladištenja.

QuestionText: Which service issues temporary, time-limited credentials for accessing AWS resources?
Explanation: AWS STS izdaje privremene kredencijale sa ograničenim trajanjem, koje koriste IAM role — za EC2 instance, Lambda funkcije i federaciju korisnika. Trajni access keys su suprotnost ovom principu.

QuestionText: How can an administrator enforce a minimum password length and password rotation for all IAM users in the account?
Options: By setting an IAM account password policy
By attaching an Amazon S3 bucket policy
By creating an IAM role for each user
Explanation: IAM account password policy postavlja pravila za sve korisnike naloga: minimalna dužina, zahtevani znakovi, istek i zabrana ponovne upotrebe lozinki.

QuestionText: A security team plans to run penetration tests against their own EC2 instances on AWS. What must they do first?
Options: Submit the penetration testing request form to AWS, following the AWS Customer Support policy for penetration testing
Nothing — penetration testing is allowed at any time without notice
Penetration testing is technically impossible on AWS
Use only Amazon Inspector, since other tools are forbidden
Explanation: AWS dozvoljava pentestiranje sopstvenih resursa uz prethodnu prijavu kroz zvanični formular (KAT tim proces), uz poštovanje liste dozvoljenih servisa i zabranjenih aktivnosti poput DNS zone walking-a.

QuestionText: Which IAM feature identifies resources — such as S3 buckets and IAM roles — that are shared with external entities, and evaluates them against zone of trust rules?
Explanation: IAM Access Analyzer analizira politike resursa i ukazuje na resurse deljene izvan poverenog opsega (npr. javno dostupan bucket), na osnovu logike zone of trust.

QuestionText: Which TWO services produce security findings that help detect threats and vulnerabilities? (Choose 2.)
Explanation: GuardDuty detektuje pretnje analizom logova, a Inspector ranjivosti na instancama i slikama kontejnera. Budgets i Cost Explorer su alati za troškove, a CloudFront je CDN.

QuestionText: For a workload running on Amazon EC2, which TWO tasks are the customer's responsibility in the shared responsibility model? (Choose 2.)
Options: Providing power and networking to the data center
Explanation: Za EC2 (IaaS model) klijent upravlja svime od guest OS-a naviše: patch-evi, security groups, aplikacija i podaci. Hardver, struja i hipervizor su AWS-ova 'of the cloud' odgovornost.

QuestionText: What is a security best practice for organizing workloads with different sensitivity levels on AWS?
Options: Use separate AWS accounts per workload or environment, grouped and governed with AWS Organizations
Keep everything in one account and share the root user among teams
Use the same IAM user for all team members
Make internal data publicly accessible for easier collaboration
Explanation: Razdvajanje po nalogima daje jaku granicu izolacije (blast radius, naplata, dozvole), a AWS Organizations omogućava centralno upravljanje i SCP granice preko svih naloga.

QuestionText: A team wants to run containers without provisioning or managing any EC2 instances or container infrastructure. Which compute option should they choose?
Explanation: AWS Fargate je serverless engine za kontejnere: pokreće ECS/EKS taskove bez upravljanja instancama — plaća se po vCPU i memoriji koje kontejner zahteva.

QuestionText: A small business wants the simplest, low-cost way to launch a virtual private server for its website, with a predictable monthly price. Which service fits best?
Options: Amazon EC2 with a Dedicated Host
Explanation: Amazon Lightsail nudi jednostavne virtuelne servere sa fiksnim mesevnim paketima (compute, storage i mreža zajedno) — namenski za male sajtove i aplikacije.

QuestionText: A developer wants to upload application code and let AWS handle capacity provisioning, load balancing, and health monitoring of the web environment. Which service does this?
Explanation: Elastic Beanstalk je PaaS servis: postaviš kod, a on upravlja instancama, balanserom i health monitoringom — uz zadržanu kontrolu nad resursima ako zatreba.

QuestionText: A company wants to run AWS services and APIs inside its own on-premises data center. Which offering supports this?
Explanation: AWS Outposts je fizička AWS infrastruktura instalirana u tvom data centru, sa istim API-jima, alatima i konzolom. Snowball je prenos podataka, Direct Connect mrežna veza, a Wavelength 5G edge.

QuestionText: Which service plans, schedules, and executes hundreds of thousands of batch computing jobs with managed scaling?
Explanation: AWS Batch pokreće velike količine batch poslova na EC2 i Fargate kapacitetu koji se skalira po zadacima posla, uz efikasno korišćenje resursa.

QuestionText: What does Amazon S3's 99.999999999% (11 nines) durability mean in practice?
Options: The service is available 11 nines of the time per year
On average, storing 10 billion objects is expected to lose about one object per year
Files are replicated to 11 separate Regions by default
Deleted objects can always be recovered within 11 days
Explanation: Durability (trajnost) meri očekivani gubitak objekata tokom vremena: 11 devetki znači statistički gubitak jednog objekta na 10 milijardi godišnje, postignuto redundantnim čuvanjem preko više AZ. Nije isto što i dostupnost servisa.

QuestionText: Secondary copies of data are accessed a few times per quarter, must be instantly available when needed, can be recreated if lost, and storage cost should be as low as possible. Which S3 storage class fits?
Explanation: S3 One Zone-IA čuva podatke u samo jednom AZ (otud niža cena od Standard-IA), uz milisekundni pristup — prihvatljivo za podatke koji se lako ponovo kreiraju. Glacier klase imaju sate preuzimanja.

QuestionText: Access patterns of stored objects are unknown and change over time. The company wants automatic cost optimization without retrieval fees or performance impact. Which S3 storage class should be used?
Explanation: S3 Intelligent-Tiering automatski premešta objekte između tier-ova po obrascu pristupa, bez naknade za preuzimanje i bez uticaja na performanse — rešenje za nepredvidive obrasce.

QuestionText: Compliance logs are accessed only a few times per month but must be available immediately when requested, and must survive the loss of an Availability Zone. Which S3 storage class is the best cost fit?
Explanation: Standard-IA je za redak ali neposredan pristup, uz replikaciju preko više AZ (za razliku od One Zone-IA). Deep Archive ima sate čekanja na preuzimanje, a Standard je preskup za redak pristup.

QuestionText: A company wants frequently accessed on-premises data cached locally on site, while durably stored in Amazon S3. Which hybrid storage service provides this?
Explanation: AWS Storage Gateway postavlja hibridni storage: lokalni keš za brz pristup uz S3 kao backend (file, volume ili tape gateway). DataSync je jednokratno/stalno sinhronizovanje, a Snowball fizički prenos.

QuestionText: A petabyte-scale video archive must be moved into AWS, but the available internet bandwidth is far too small for the transfer window. Which service solves this?
Explanation: AWS Snowball Edge su fizički uređaji za prenos velikih količina podataka offline — pošalju se, popune i vrate. Direct Connect je mrežna veza koja i dalje zavisi od protoka, a CloudFront je CDN.

QuestionText: Which service centrally manages and automates backups across services such as EC2, RDS, DynamoDB, and EFS from a single place?
Explanation: AWS Backup objedinjuje politike backup-a (planove) i kopije preko više servisa i naloga, umesto ručnog podešavanja svakog servisa posebno.

QuestionText: A company runs MySQL and wants an AWS-native database that is MySQL-compatible, with higher performance and storage that automatically grows. Which service should they choose?
Explanation: Amazon Aurora je MySQL i PostgreSQL kompatibilna relacionalna baza sa pojačanim performansama (do 5x MySQL), automatskim skaliranjem skladišta i replikama u više AZ.

QuestionText: An application needs microsecond-latency reads for repeated queries to reduce database load. Which service provides an in-memory cache?
Explanation: Amazon ElastiCache je upravljani in-memory keš (Redis ili Memcached) za podatke koji se često čitaju, čime se smanjuje latencija i opterećenje baze.

QuestionText: A company wants to migrate an Oracle database to Amazon RDS while the source keeps running, with minimal downtime. Which service performs this?
Explanation: AWS DMS replikuje podatke između izvorišne i odredišne baze (istočne ili različite platforme) uz minimalan prekid — migracija je praktično uživo.

QuestionText: Which THREE factors should drive the choice of an AWS Region for a workload? (Choose 3.)
Options: Proximity to users, which affects latency
Costs of services, which vary between Regions
The programming language of the application
The number of IAM users in the account
Explanation: Glavni faktori izbora Regiona: gde podaci smeju da budu (rezidencija), koliko su korisnici blizu (latencija), cena po Regionu i dostupnost željenih servisa. Programski jezik i broj IAM korisnika ne utiču.

QuestionText: Which service lets a team create, publish, maintain, and secure REST APIs at any scale, and charge for their usage?
Explanation: Amazon API Gateway je upravljani ulaz za API-je: autorizacija, throttling, verzije i naplata po pozivu, uz integraciju sa Lambda i EC2 backend-om.

QuestionText: A company needs a dedicated private network connection between its data center and AWS, bypassing the public internet. Which service provides this?
Options: AWS Site-to-Site VPN over the internet
Explanation: AWS Direct Connect je namenska fizicka veza sa konzistentnom latencijom i većom propusnošću; VPN ide preko interneta (jeftinije, ali javnom mrežom).

QuestionText: A pipeline must send one event notification to multiple subscribers at once — email, SMS, and an AWS Lambda function. Which service provides this pub/sub pattern?
Explanation: Amazon SNS je pub/sub servis: jedna objava (topic) dostavlja se više pretplatnika odjednom. SQS je red poruka gde jedan potrošač uzima jednu poruku — push vs pull obrazac.

QuestionText: Which service routes events from AWS services and custom applications to targets such as Lambda functions, using rules that match event patterns?
Explanation: Amazon EventBridge je serverless event bus: pravila prepoznaju događaje (npr. promena u EC2 ili vlastiti događaji aplikacije) i usmeravaju ih na ciljeve poput Lambda funkcija.

QuestionText: Which service moves large amounts of data between on-premises storage and AWS over the network, with scheduling, monitoring, and integrity validation?
Explanation: AWS DataSync automatizuje online prenos podataka (NFS/S3/HDFS...) uz zakazivanje, proveru integriteta i ubrzanje mreže. Za offline prenos ogromnih skupova koristi se Snowball.

QuestionText: Which service lets engineers define AWS infrastructure as code in declarative templates and provision it repeatably and automatically?
Explanation: AWS CloudFormation opisuje resurse u šablonima (JSON/YAML) i kreira ih kao jedan stack — ponovljivo, verzionisano i sa rollback-om. CloudWatch prati metrike, a Config stanje resursa.

QuestionText: Which service helps patch a fleet of EC2 instances, run automation scripts across them, and access their configuration at scale?
Explanation: AWS Systems Manager objedinjuje operativne zadatke: Patch Manager, Run Command, Session Manager (SSH-less pristup) i inventar resursa preko više instanci i naloga.

QuestionText: Which service automatically adds or removes EC2 instances based on demand or a defined schedule?
Explanation: EC2 Auto Scaling održava željeni broj instanci preko scaling politika (npr. po CPU iskorišćenosti) — temelj elastičnosti na AWS-u.

QuestionText: Which service distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets — such as EC2 instances in several Availability Zones — and offloads unhealthy ones?
Explanation: Elastic Load Balancing raspoređuje saobraćaj na zdrave ciljeve u više AZ i drži ga dalje od instanci koje padnu — ključni deo visoke dostupnosti.

QuestionText: Where can a team centralize logs from applications and EC2 instances for search, filtering, and retention?
Explanation: CloudWatch Logs prikuplja, pretražuje i čuva logove aplikacija i instanci (uz metrike i alarme). CloudTrail je specijalizovan za API aktivnost naloga.

QuestionText: Which service improves availability and performance for global TCP or UDP users by routing traffic over the AWS network with static anycast IP addresses?
Explanation: Global Accelerator dva statička anycast IP-a i usmerava saobraćaj kroz AWS backbone do najbližeg zdravog regiona — za ne-HTTP protokole i hitne failover scenarije. CloudFront kešira HTTP sadržaj.

QuestionText: A company needs a managed Windows file system with SMB support, shared by multiple servers. Which service fits?
Options: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
Explanation: FSx for Windows File Server je potpuno upravljani nativni Windows fajl sistem (SMB, Active Directory). EFS je za Linux workload-e, EBS blokovski volumen uz jednu instancu, a S3 objektni storage.

QuestionText: Which Amazon S3 feature keeps multiple variants of an object and protects against accidental deletion or overwrite?
Explanation: S3 Versioning čuva sve verzije objekta (uključujući prebrisane i obrisane markere), pa se greškom izgubljen objekat može vratiti.

QuestionText: Which AWS infrastructure option places compute and storage geographically close to end users in a specific metropolitan area, for latency-sensitive workloads that stay AWS-managed?
Explanation: Local Zones donose EC2, EBS i slične servise u metro područja blizu korisnika. Wavelength je edge za 5G uređaje, Outposts je infrastruktura u tvom data centru, a edge lokacije su CloudFront CDN keš.

QuestionText: Which service stores and manages Docker container images with high availability and integrates with Amazon ECS and EKS?
Explanation: Amazon ECR je upravljani registar kontejnerskih slika (Docker/OCI) sa skeniranjem slika i integracijom u ECS/EKS deployment pipeline-e.

QuestionText: Which TWO AWS storage services can be mounted as a shared file system by multiple servers at the same time? (Choose 2.)
Options: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
Explanation: EFS (Linux/NFS) i FSx (Windows/SMB) su deljeni fajl sistemi za više servera. EBS se kači na jednu instancu, a S3 i Glacier su objektni storage bez montiranja.
